description: Work the Source Monitor: open a clip project item (optionally at a time), play it at a speed (Play-Stop Toggle; negative plays backward, as the J, K and L shuttle keys do), close the clip or every clip, report what is open, or Match Frame (Sequence > Match Frame: open the source of a sequence clip at the frame under the playhead). Positioning needs Premiere Pro 26.3 or later. Playback is the Source Monitor only: the Program Monitor cannot be played from a script

clip.description: With match_frame: the clip; default the clip under the playhead on the highest video track that has one, else on the first audio track that has one

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

item.description: With open: the clip project item to open

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

position.description: With open: show this time, seconds into the media (26.3 or later)

sequence.description: With match_frame: the sequence (default the active one)

speed.description: With play: playback speed, 1 = normal, negative plays backward, 0 stops. Default 1

name: control_source_monitor
title: Control Source Monitor
